items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: the last time I saw Gene we worked together in Chicago at a club

ctx.x: Let's see, who did I work with last -- all right, last night in Larchmont I worked with Gene Rodgers who is a very good pianist and I haven't seen Gene in forty years, the last time I saw Gene we worked together in Chicago at a club and he was accompanying and working with -- they had a comedy act -- Radcliffe and Rodgers. But we would have sessions together, you know, after work, he was a very good pianist. So he showed up last night.

So as I said before, I've been quite lucky. The guys seem to know where I'm going and there's no clashes and no problems. It would be easier -- I can't even think of any bad ones -- to think up a bad one would be to think up the good ones.
